thresholdPolicy: PROVISIONAL values are proposed protective defaults, not reconstructed 2026 percentiles or capacity limits. BASELINE REQUIRED values must be calibrated with two event-shaped rehearsals. SAFETY INVARIANT values are exact correctness or authority conditions.

defaultDestinations.pager: Incident Commander and application/database on-call; exact integration and people BASELINE REQUIRED
defaultDestinations.ops-channel: Tournament operations channel; exact integration BASELINE REQUIRED
defaultDestinations.provider-support: Human-opened provider case with bounded evidence packet

monitors.name: Supabase Disk I/O budget
monitors.condition: Daily Disk I/O budget consumed and projected depletion during an event
monitors.green: <1% consumed and no depletion projection
monitors.yellow: 1% to <50%, or projected exhaustion after event close
monitors.red: >=50% during event, projected exhaustion before close, provider depletion warning, or instance unresponsive with I/O evidence
monitors.window: Gauge every scrape; projection over 15 minutes
monitors.ownerAction: Confirm metric semantics/account configuration, inspect I/O wait/query/temp/checkpoint workload, and decide shedding or emergency change
monitors.autoAction: At yellow pause P4/P5; at red pause P2-P5 where preapproved and serve time-stamped public snapshot
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 red; SEV-1 if scoring/authority unavailable; human may open provider-support case
monitors.recovery: Below approved event threshold for 30 minutes with scoring healthy and low-priority work still paused
monitors.rationale: Provider documentation says >1% means baseline was exceeded and 100% means budget used; 50% is a conservative event guardrail requiring rehearsal calibration
monitors.evidenceConfidence: Owner-reported warning in 2026; underlying Production metric unavailable

monitors.name: Database I/O latency and wait
monitors.condition: Read/write latency, I/O wait, queue depth, IOPS and throughput approach the selected resource limit
monitors.green: Inside approved rehearsal envelope
monitors.yellow: Sustained deviation above approved yellow envelope
monitors.red: Approved red envelope breached or scoring latency/error correlated with I/O saturation
monitors.ownerAction: Inspect top query/temp/WAL/checkpoint contributors and capacity limit; preserve evidence
monitors.autoAction: Pause P4/P5 at yellow and P2-P5 at red where preapproved
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 red; SEV-1 when P0/P1 impaired
monitors.recovery: All I/O signals within approved green envelope for 30 minutes and scoring budgets met
monitors.rationale: Actual 2026 IOPS, throughput and I/O wait were not captured

monitors.name: Pool and backend connection headroom
monitors.condition: Pool clients/backends, acquisition wait, queue and rejection by role/workload
monitors.green: Within approved role allocations with reserved P0/P1 headroom
monitors.yellow: Approved warning allocation or acquisition-wait envelope exceeded
monitors.red: Rejection, login-role initialization failure, or P0/P1 cannot acquire a connection
monitors.window: Immediate on rejection; gauges over 1 and 5 minutes
monitors.ownerAction: Identify role/workload consuming connections, shed lower priority, verify pool health
monitors.autoAction: Reject/queue excess P2-P5 and pause background workers per policy
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 for P0/P1; otherwise SEV-2
monitors.recovery: No failures and approved headroom for 15 minutes
monitors.rationale: A September 26 failure occurred during connection initialization, but pool metrics were unavailable
monitors.evidenceConfidence: Failure phase proven; underlying cause unknown

monitors.name: Statement and lock timeout
monitors.condition: SQLSTATE 57014, statement timeout, lock timeout or canceled statement by role/query fingerprint
monitors.green: Zero scoring timeouts and diagnostics cancel inside their budget
monitors.yellow: One background timeout or rising near-timeout duration
monitors.red: Any scoring timeout, repeated current-read timeout, or diagnostic exceeds role timeout
monitors.ownerAction: Classify query/phase, confirm rollback or unknown outcome, inspect plan/waits, contain workload
monitors.autoAction: Pause implicated background worker; never retry an interactive mutation blindly
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 for unknown score outcome; SEV-2 for rolled-back scoring timeout
monitors.recovery: Authoritative outcomes resolved and no recurrence for 30 minutes under event-shaped load
monitors.rationale: September 27 scoring failures were proven eight-second statement timeouts

monitors.name: Long transaction and blocking lock
monitors.condition: Open transaction age, idle-in-transaction, blocked critical query or deadlock
monitors.green: Inside approved transaction-age and lock-wait budgets
monitors.yellow: Noncritical transaction exceeds warning budget
monitors.red: Critical score/authority query blocked, deadlock, or transaction exceeds kill-review budget
monitors.ownerAction: Identify owner/query/operation; determine safe cancellation through incident command
monitors.autoAction: No automatic backend termination
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 for score integrity/authority; otherwise SEV-2
monitors.recovery: Blocker cleared, authoritative write outcomes known and no recurrence for 15 minutes
monitors.rationale: No 2026 lock/transaction baseline was retained

monitors.name: Temporary I/O and query spill
monitors.condition: Temp files/bytes or temp blocks by query fingerprint/workload class
monitors.green: No temp spill on scoring/authority; background inside approved envelope
monitors.yellow: New or rising spill on current/side-game workload
monitors.red: Any large spill in synchronous score path or resource red state correlated with spill
monitors.ownerAction: Disable implicated background/derived path and inspect plan on isolated data
monitors.autoAction: Pause associated background worker
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 if score path or capacity red; otherwise ticket
monitors.recovery: No prohibited spill and resource signals green for 30 minutes
monitors.rationale: The 407-row growth case proved temp reads/writes for the original query shape
monitors.evidenceConfidence: HIGH for query test; outage causation UNKNOWN

monitors.name: CPU and memory pressure
monitors.condition: CPU, runnable work, memory, swap and OOM/restart indicators
monitors.green: Inside approved rehearsal envelope
monitors.yellow: Sustained warning envelope breach or declining memory headroom
monitors.red: Approved red breach, swap/OOM, restart, or P0/P1 impairment
monitors.ownerAction: Correlate workload/query/connections and decide shedding or emergency capacity change
monitors.autoAction: Pause P4/P5 and then P2/P3 per policy
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 red; SEV-1 with scoring/authority outage
monitors.recovery: Approved green headroom for 30 minutes
monitors.rationale: Only a later point-in-time 4% CPU/26% memory observation exists

monitors.name: Database restart or provider configuration change
monitors.condition: Postmaster start time changes or compute/storage/pool/parameter/region change event occurs
monitors.green: No unplanned change
monitors.yellow: Approved scheduled change outside Tournament Mode
monitors.red: Unplanned restart/change or any change during frozen/active event
monitors.ownerAction: Freeze changes, correlate exact provider/change event and validate authority/data semantics
monitors.autoAction: Capture evidence packet and hold background workers
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 if availability/integrity affected; otherwise SEV-2
monitors.recovery: Cause/change recorded and health, authority and semantic checks pass through observation window
monitors.rationale: A September 26 postmaster start time proves a restart but not its cause
monitors.evidenceConfidence: HIGH for restart timestamp; UNKNOWN cause

monitors.name: Forbidden history query on primary
monitors.condition: Tournament runtime or diagnostic role accesses history schema/broad history RPC on primary
monitors.green: Zero attempts and grant tests pass
monitors.yellow: Denied attempt
monitors.red: Any successful execution or unbounded scan begins
monitors.ownerAction: Terminate/contain through approved incident procedure, identify route/credential and preserve query evidence
monitors.autoAction: Database grants deny access; route returns bounded failure with no retry
monitors.escalation: SEV-2; SEV-1 if P0/P1 impaired
monitors.recovery: Path revoked/fixed and negative access tests pass
monitors.rationale: A broad 2026 diagnostic exceeded 90 seconds; causation was not proven, so prevention is technical
monitors.evidenceConfidence: HIGH for query risk; UNKNOWN for outage causation

monitors.name: Diagnostic role guardrails
monitors.condition: Diagnostic pool size/in-flight count/timeout/read-only/tag/view scope deviates
monitors.green: Pool size 1, one in flight, read-only, tagged, allowlisted current views, within timeout
monitors.yellow: Denied policy violation
monitors.red: Concurrent diagnostic execution, write privilege, missing timeout/tag or non-allowlisted access succeeds
monitors.ownerAction: Revoke diagnostic access and repair grants/configuration
monitors.autoAction: Reject query; no retry
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 during Tournament Mode; otherwise security/reliability ticket
monitors.recovery: Privileges/configuration revalidated and deliberate-negative test passes
monitors.rationale: Protects the primary while preserving bounded incident evidence

monitors.name: Backup and PITR freshness
monitors.condition: Backup job status, latest/earliest recovery point or recovery window becomes stale/missing
monitors.green: Inside verified account policy and event gate
monitors.yellow: Approaching freshness/retention guardrail
monitors.red: Failed/missing backup, lost required recovery window or status unknown at Tournament entry
monitors.ownerAction: Verify provider account state and block Tournament entry or risky change
monitors.autoAction: Fail entry gate; never initiate restore automatically
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 near/within event; otherwise urgent ticket
monitors.recovery: Verified recovery point restored to required window and evidence captured
monitors.rationale: Production backup/PITR configuration was not supplied

monitors.name: Read replica lag and routing
monitors.condition: Replica replay lag, error, or primary fallback for archive/analytics
monitors.green: Lag inside published freshness budget and zero primary fallback
monitors.yellow: Lag above warning budget; stale label active
monitors.red: Lag above safety budget, routing error, or history falls back to primary
monitors.ownerAction: Disable archive/analytics and serve snapshot/unavailable response
monitors.autoAction: Circuit-break archive/history; never fall back to primary
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 if primary risk; otherwise SEV-3
monitors.recovery: Lag green and routing tests prove isolation
monitors.rationale: Replica is a proposed control, not verified current architecture

monitors.name: Critical API semantic availability
monitors.condition: Authority, current tournament, score read/mutation or recovery returns failure by semantic result
monitors.green: Approved success rate and zero safety failures
monitors.yellow: Noncritical/current-public degradation
monitors.red: Any score commit/recovery unavailable or two consecutive authority/current probes fail
monitors.ownerAction: Enter INCIDENT, classify failed dependency/component and preserve evidence
monitors.autoAction: Shed lower priorities and enable approved public snapshot
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 for scoring/authority; otherwise SEV-2
monitors.recovery: Semantic probes plus physical journey healthy for configured observation window
monitors.rationale: HTTP status alone cannot establish correctness; rate thresholds need rehearsal

monitors.name: API latency by journey
monitors.condition: p50/p95/p99 and max for current, scoring, recovery, public and history journeys
monitors.green: Meets ratified journey budget
monitors.yellow: p95 above green or forecast breach
monitors.red: Ratified red budget breached or hard request timeout
monitors.window: Rolling 5 and 15 minutes with sample count
monitors.ownerAction: Inspect server/dependency/database/cache splits and workload class
monitors.autoAction: Reduce P2 refresh and pause P3-P5 where approved
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 sustained; SEV-1 if scoring unavailable/unknown
monitors.recovery: Budget met for 30 minutes with minimum valid sample count
monitors.rationale: Proposed journey budgets are in 28-PERFORMANCE-BUDGETS.md; two-request 2026 probes are not percentiles

monitors.name: Dependency and database time share
monitors.condition: Per-request network, pool, database and downstream phase duration changes
monitors.green: Inside approved phase envelopes
monitors.yellow: One phase exceeds warning envelope
monitors.red: Dependency failure/timeout or critical phase breaches hard budget
monitors.ownerAction: Assign incident to observed component without inferring provider cause
monitors.autoAction: None beyond workload-class policy
monitors.escalation: Severity follows affected journey
monitors.recovery: Phase metrics and journey budget green for 30 minutes
monitors.rationale: 2026 logs lacked server/upstream duration needed for root cause

monitors.name: Public snapshot freshness and cache
monitors.condition: Snapshot age, cache hit/miss, refresh rate and origin request rate
monitors.green: Inside approved freshness/cache/load budget
monitors.yellow: Snapshot/cache warning budget exceeded
monitors.red: Staleness exceeds published safety budget or origin load threatens P0/P1
monitors.ownerAction: Confirm displayed timestamp and decide public degradation message
monitors.autoAction: Increase refresh interval or serve last-known-good snapshot per policy
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 if primary threatened; otherwise SEV-3
monitors.recovery: Freshness/cache/origin load green for 15 minutes
monitors.rationale: Spectator demand and cache behavior were not measured in 2026

monitors.name: Payload and physical time to usable
monitors.condition: Response bytes, dependency count, TTFB and physical-device time to usable
monitors.green: Inside approved journey budgets
monitors.yellow: Regression above warning budget
monitors.red: Current-round journey exceeds hard budget or cannot become usable
monitors.window: Per release and rolling event window
monitors.ownerAction: Identify payload/dependency/client/server regression
monitors.autoAction: None
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 if active participants blocked; otherwise SEV-3
monitors.recovery: Physical and synthetic journey pass on approved builds
monitors.rationale: Build 9 observations lacked statistically valid samples and server timing

monitors.name: Unknown score outcome
monitors.condition: Transport/client loses response without authoritative receipt or canonical readback
monitors.green: Zero unresolved unknown outcomes; injected qualification unknowns have completed safe same-ID recovery
monitors.yellow: Not applicable
monitors.red: One unknown outcome
monitors.ownerAction: Freeze the affected operation and recover with the same operation identity
monitors.autoAction: Prevent new-identity retry and preserve evidence
monitors.escalation: SEV-1
monitors.recovery: Same-ID receipt/canonical readback proves committed or rolled back and reconciliation completes
monitors.rationale: A transient lost response is possible and deliberately injected in qualification; competitive correctness requires it to stay red until same-ID recovery resolves it without duplicate replay

monitors.name: Score timeout or error
monitors.condition: Score RPC error, SQLSTATE, rollback, timeout or repeated rejection by cause
monitors.green: Zero unexpected errors/timeouts
monitors.yellow: Single conflict/rejection correctly resolved
monitors.red: Any timeout/500 or repeated unexpected failure
monitors.ownerAction: Verify rollback versus unknown, isolate phase/query and contain derived/background work
monitors.autoAction: No blind retry; allow explicit same-ID recovery
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 rolled back; SEV-1 unknown or widespread
monitors.recovery: Affected outcomes authoritative and successful physical scores stable for 30 minutes
monitors.rationale: September 27 score failures returned 500 after statement timeout and rolled back

monitors.name: Score latency
monitors.condition: End-to-end and database transaction latency distributions
monitors.green: Proposed p95 <=2s, p99 <=4s; transaction p95 <=1s, p99 <=2s
monitors.yellow: p95 or p99 exceeds proposed green
monitors.red: End-to-end p95 >4s for 5 minutes or any timeout/unknown
monitors.window: Rolling 5 minutes with sample count plus per-request hard failures
monitors.ownerAction: Inspect phase trace, pool, locks, trigger/function and resource signals
monitors.autoAction: Pause P3-P5, reduce P2 refresh
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 sustained; SEV-1 unknown/unavailable
monitors.recovery: Both budgets met for 30 minutes under active event shape
monitors.rationale: Leaves margin below the observed eight-second statement timeout; requires rehearsal ratification

monitors.name: Canonical, receipt and audit agreement
monitors.condition: Canonical score differs from idempotency receipt/history/audit or expected revision
monitors.green: Exact agreement
monitors.yellow: Not applicable
monitors.red: Any mismatch, missing receipt/audit or revision regression
monitors.window: Immediate per mutation and periodic bounded reconciliation
monitors.ownerAction: Stop affected writes and begin integrity reconciliation
monitors.autoAction: Fence affected operation/match; no automatic overwrite
monitors.escalation: SEV-1
monitors.recovery: Four-eyes reconciliation and immutable repair receipt complete
monitors.rationale: Canonical correctness outranks availability

monitors.name: Duplicate physical hole row
monitors.condition: More than one canonical physical record for the same stable match/golfer/hole identity
monitors.green: Zero duplicates
monitors.yellow: Not applicable
monitors.red: One duplicate or uniqueness invariant bypass
monitors.window: Immediate on write plus bounded reconciliation
monitors.ownerAction: Fence affected match and reconcile under incident protocol
monitors.autoAction: Database uniqueness rejects duplicate
monitors.escalation: SEV-1
monitors.recovery: Canonical state and all receipts/audit repaired and verified
monitors.rationale: Physical recovery evidence used duplicate-safe matching; the invariant must be enforced

monitors.name: Outbox durability
monitors.condition: Canonical score commit lacks exactly one durable side-game/domain outbox event or event cannot be replayed idempotently
monitors.green: One durable event per canonical mutation and worker replay is idempotent
monitors.yellow: Event pending inside freshness budget
monitors.red: Missing/duplicate semantic event or score transaction depends on worker completion
monitors.ownerAction: Preserve canonical score, pause consumer and repair event under receipt
monitors.autoAction: Retry idempotent background event within bounded policy
monitors.escalation: SEV-2; SEV-1 if score commit correctness affected
monitors.recovery: Outbox/canonical agreement restored and consumer catch-up verified
monitors.rationale: Moves derived work outside the scoring transaction without losing causality

monitors.name: Authority component health
monitors.condition: Read-control, admission, runtime, identity, connection or aggregate compatibility component fails
monitors.green: All components pass inside ratified latency budget
monitors.yellow: One component slow but aggregate safe
monitors.red: Any required component fails or two consecutive aggregate probes are incompatible
monitors.ownerAction: Use component span and provider/resource evidence to classify impact
monitors.autoAction: Fail closed and shed lower-priority work
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 when play blocked; otherwise SEV-2
monitors.recovery: All component probes and physical journey pass for configured health window
monitors.rationale: INC-022/023 surfaced only aggregate AUTHORITY_INCOMPATIBLE; components were hidden
monitors.evidenceConfidence: Outages HIGH; failed component UNKNOWN overnight

monitors.name: Split or multiple writer authority
monitors.condition: More than one valid writer generation/target or inconsistent authority reads
monitors.green: Exactly one writer authority and consistent generation
monitors.yellow: Pending transition fully fenced
monitors.red: Two writers, generation mismatch or unfenced ambiguous transition
monitors.ownerAction: Fence writes and invoke protected authority recovery
monitors.autoAction: Fail closed
monitors.escalation: SEV-1
monitors.recovery: Exactly one authority verified independently and semantic checks pass
monitors.rationale: Single-writer correctness boundary

monitors.name: Release, activation, migration and authority drift
monitors.condition: Observed deployment/release/activation/migration/config/authority differs from sealed manifest
monitors.green: Exact manifest match
monitors.yellow: Approved pending intent during change window
monitors.red: Unapproved drift or mismatch in freeze/Tournament Mode
monitors.ownerAction: Stop release/change, identify authoritative state and choose rollback/forward recovery
monitors.autoAction: Block entry/promotion and capture evidence
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 if authority/scoring affected; otherwise SEV-2
monitors.recovery: Manifest exact and health/competitive diff windows pass
monitors.rationale: A shell/deployment success cannot prove authority compatibility

monitors.name: Region inventory and latency
monitors.condition: Function/database region unknown or network phase exceeds approved envelope
monitors.green: Regions recorded and network latency inside approved envelope
monitors.yellow: Inventory drift/unknown outside Tournament Mode or latency warning
monitors.red: Region/config drift in Tournament Mode or network latency blocks P0/P1
monitors.ownerAction: Record actual regions and test proposed change in rehearsal before modifying
monitors.autoAction: Block Tournament entry on unknown inventory
monitors.escalation: P1 remediation; SEV-2 only on active impairment
monitors.recovery: Recorded configuration and network phase remain green
monitors.rationale: Source contained no region setting and dashboard configuration could differ

monitors.name: Synchronous side-game work in score path
monitors.condition: Score transaction executes whole-history hash, broad invalidation, derived calculation or publication
monitors.green: Only small outbox event inside canonical transaction
monitors.yellow: Not applicable
monitors.red: Any prohibited synchronous derived/history work
monitors.window: Per score trace and CI/rehearsal policy
monitors.ownerAction: Disable derived integration path and preserve canonical scoring
monitors.autoAction: Feature/control gate rejects prohibited path
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 during play; release blocker otherwise
monitors.recovery: Trace proves bounded canonical transaction and parity tests pass
monitors.rationale: September 27 stack and query tests proved material synchronous cost

monitors.name: Side-game queue age and depth
monitors.condition: Oldest ready job age, queue depth and processing rate
monitors.green: Oldest age <=30s and stable/draining
monitors.yellow: Age >30s to 120s or growth exceeds drain
monitors.red: Age >120s during play or queue stalled
monitors.ownerAction: Inspect worker/dependency, confirm canonical scores unaffected and communicate calculated-projection staleness; owner publication remains separate
monitors.autoAction: Bounded idempotent retries; pause worker if resource pressure/red dependency
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 red; SEV-3 yellow
monitors.recovery: Queue drained and publication/fingerprint checks pass
monitors.rationale: Calculated/current eligible projection freshness target requires tournament-owner ratification; owner publication timing is separate

monitors.name: Side-game worker failure and dead letter
monitors.condition: Worker failure, retry exhaustion, dead-letter event or duplicate consumer effect
monitors.green: Zero unhandled/dead-letter and bounded successful retries
monitors.yellow: One retryable failure
monitors.red: Dead letter, repeated failure, duplicate result or primary resource harm
monitors.ownerAction: Pause consumer, preserve event/inputs and repair idempotently
monitors.autoAction: Bounded exponential retry only for classified idempotent failure
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 red; SEV-1 if scoring/canonical data affected
monitors.recovery: Replay produces one correct result and queue/fingerprint checks pass
monitors.rationale: Async isolation must not trade score safety for silent derived loss

monitors.name: Side-game calculated projection freshness and fingerprint
monitors.condition: Calculated/current eligible projection age or input/result fingerprint differs from canonical inputs; owner-reviewed publication timing is observed separately
monitors.green: Eligible calculated projection available <=30s and fingerprints match
monitors.yellow: Eligible calculated projection age >30s to 120s with stale label
monitors.red: Eligible calculated projection age >120s, unlabeled stale calculation or fingerprint mismatch
monitors.ownerAction: Hold or unpublish the affected result and rebuild from canonical inputs; review publication state/age separately
monitors.autoAction: Mark the calculated projection stale; never publish a mismatched result
monitors.escalation: SEV-2; owner notification for competitive impact
monitors.recovery: Rebuilt eligible projection and fingerprint verified; publication remains a separate owner-authorized action
monitors.rationale: Calculation freshness needs owner acceptance; human publication delay is excluded, while correctness mismatch is invariant

monitors.name: Release preflight and manifest completeness
monitors.condition: Required candidate/config/authority/migration/backup/observability/rollback field or check missing
monitors.green: All exact fields and checks pass
monitors.yellow: Nonblocking rehearsal warning with named owner
monitors.red: Any required field/check missing or mismatch
monitors.ownerAction: Stop promotion/entry and resolve discrepancy
monitors.autoAction: Block release/entry
monitors.escalation: Release blocker; SEV-2 for drift during Tournament Mode
monitors.recovery: Exact rerun passes and evidence is retained
monitors.rationale: Exact release/authority evidence is required before exposing writes

monitors.name: Freeze violation
monitors.condition: Code/schema/config/provider/cron/authority change occurs outside allowed freeze policy
monitors.green: No unapproved changes
monitors.yellow: Approved emergency intent pending execution
monitors.red: Unapproved or unreceipted change
monitors.ownerAction: Stop change, assess exact state and invoke emergency protocol
monitors.autoAction: Block protected pipeline action and capture evidence
monitors.escalation: SEV-2; SEV-1 if authority/data integrity affected
monitors.recovery: State matches approved manifest and health/semantic window passes
monitors.rationale: Prevents emergency scope drift and unaudited provider changes

monitors.name: Post-change health window
monitors.condition: Authority components, scoring journey, resource/query metrics or physical probe regress after change
monitors.green: All approved signals pass for full window
monitors.yellow: Noncritical warning inside stated abort budget
monitors.red: Any abort criterion, safety failure or missing telemetry
monitors.window: Configured per change; minimum value BASELINE REQUIRED
monitors.ownerAction: Abort and execute safe rollback/forward recovery
monitors.autoAction: Hold further rollout and background work
monitors.escalation: Severity follows failed invariant
monitors.recovery: Fresh complete window passes on exact final state
monitors.rationale: Release completion requires more than deployment success

monitors.name: Competitive data diff
monitors.condition: Candidate/change alters canonical score, standings, side-game or eligibility outside approved expectation
monitors.green: Zero unexplained competitive diff
monitors.yellow: Expected diff explicitly approved and receipted
monitors.red: Any unexplained or unbounded diff
monitors.ownerAction: Stop activation/publication and reconcile source records
monitors.autoAction: Block closeout/publication
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 for canonical score; SEV-2 for derived/public result
monitors.recovery: Four-eyes verified diff and immutable receipt
monitors.rationale: Competitive effects require explicit human accountability

monitors.name: Observability pipeline health
monitors.condition: Metrics scrape, log ingestion, trace export, alert evaluation or evidence storage missing/delayed
monitors.green: All sources current inside approved ingestion delay
monitors.yellow: One missed interval outside Tournament Mode
monitors.red: More than two scrape intervals missing or any critical telemetry absent in Tournament Mode
monitors.ownerAction: Restore pipeline and treat capacity/root-cause claims as unknown
monitors.autoAction: Fail Tournament entry; capture local fallback evidence where safe
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 during Tournament Mode; SEV-3 otherwise
monitors.recovery: All sources current and gap recorded/backfilled where possible
monitors.rationale: Two intervals is a protective default; interval duration requires chosen platform

monitors.name: Incident evidence packet completion
monitors.condition: SEV-1/SEV-2 lacks required pre/post metrics, logs, traces, query/change/release/backup/queue evidence
monitors.green: Immutable packet complete and access-controlled
monitors.yellow: Capture in progress within collection window
monitors.red: Missing/failed packet or collector violates bounded-read policy
monitors.window: From 15 minutes pre-alert through at least 30 minutes after
monitors.ownerAction: Run bounded fallback collection and record irrecoverable gaps
monitors.autoAction: Start read-only bounded collection; never execute history aggregation
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 observability gap
monitors.recovery: Packet complete or gaps formally recorded UNKNOWN
monitors.rationale: INC-025 is cross-cutting inability to establish root cause

monitors.name: Restore rehearsal age and result
monitors.condition: Last isolated semantic restore is stale, failed or lacks measured RPO/RTO
monitors.green: Quarterly and pre-tournament exercise passed inside approved targets
monitors.yellow: Approaching due date
monitors.red: Overdue/failed or no passing pre-tournament exercise
monitors.window: Daily governance check and Tournament entry
monitors.ownerAction: Schedule/perform isolated restore and block entry if required
monitors.autoAction: Fail Tournament entry; never start restore automatically
monitors.escalation: SEV-2 if active recovery readiness is invalid; otherwise urgent governance
monitors.recovery: Semantic restore passes with measured RPO/RTO and evidence
monitors.rationale: Quarterly plus pre-event cadence is proposed; owner must ratify

monitors.name: Paper/offline reconciliation
monitors.condition: Paper authority open, manual records unreceipted, or reconciliation conflict/age exceeds policy
monitors.green: No open paper authority or all records reconciled with four-eyes receipts
monitors.yellow: Paper mode active with complete witnessed records
monitors.red: Missing/conflicting record, dual paper/digital writer, or overdue reconciliation
monitors.window: Immediate and every 15 minutes during RECOVERY
monitors.ownerAction: Fence digital writes as needed and resolve each stable identity with four eyes
monitors.autoAction: Block silent overwrite and final publication
monitors.escalation: SEV-1 for dual authority/canonical conflict
monitors.recovery: Every record reconciled and paper authority formally closed
monitors.rationale: Manual continuity requires explicit single authority and audit
